failures.question: 2018 年每个月的订单量相比 2017 年同期增长了多少？
failures.generatedSql:
-- 按月份对齐 2017 与 2018 年订单量并计算同比增长率
SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS month,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01') AS orders_2017,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01') AS orders_2018,
       ROUND(
         (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01')
          - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01'))::numeric
         / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01'), 0),
       4) AS growth_rate
FROM orders
WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
LIMIT 12;

-- 按客户登记州分组，对比默认收货州与登记州一致/不一致的订单量，取订单量前 20 个州
SELECT
  c.customer_state,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FILTER (WHERE sa.state = c.customer_state) AS same_state_orders,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FILTER (WHERE sa.state <> c.customer_state) AS diff_state_orders
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN shipping_addresses sa ON sa.customer_id = c.customer_id AND sa.is_default = true
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) DESC
LIMIT 20;

  c.customer_state,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FILTER (WHERE sa.state = c.customer_state) AS same_state_orders,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FILTER (WHERE sa.state <> c.customer_state) AS diff_state_orders
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN shipping_addresses sa ON sa.customer_id = c.customer_id AND sa.is_default = true
